tips.text: Bank Aya and buy relics whenever you can; neither expires when Varzia's stock rotates.
Buy extra relics for the Blueprint; every one carries it as the Rare.
Buy her relics from the Market console on your Orbiter to skip the trip to Maroo's Bazaar.
Refine the Rare and Uncommon relics to Radiant and run them in a radshare squad.
Leave the Handle relics Intact; Radiant lowers their Common odds.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen so they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
